question: Select the most appropriate option for blank(4)
solution:
The correct answer is: **transmitted**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"transmitted"** means to send or convey from one person or place to another; spread. (प्रेषित करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The message was transmitted via email to all the employees.
 
 
 
• Similarly, in this context, it is said that Measles is an extremely contagious virus that spreads by respiratory droplets from an infected person's cough, sneeze, or breath.
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct answer is **"transmitted"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **transmitted**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **transported** (परिवहन करना): To carry or move from one place to another.

 
 
• **Example:** The goods were transported by truck to the warehouse.
 
 
 
• **transited** (आवागमन करना): To pass through or across.
 
 
• **Example:** The airplane transited over several countries before reaching its destination.
 
 
 
• **transgressed** (उल्लंघन करना): To violate a law, command, or moral code.
 
 
• **Example:** The company transgressed environmental laws by dumping waste into the river.
 
 

42:Tb84,

The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. outbreak
